title: Spikes and stop rules
summary: Teach runners that dying costs more than a detour, and find the bug in a stop rule that fires too soon.

steps.title: A price for dying
steps.body:
From level 3 on, courses have spike pads, and later moving crates that crush. Touching either ends the run.

Right now a runner that dies keeps the points it won on the way. A brave dash that hits the spikes scores almost as well as a careful detour.

`agent.died` is true on the tick a runner dies. Take 3 points away for it.

check.message: Add a negative reward when agent.died is true.

hints: A penalty is a reward with a minus sign.

steps.title: A stop rule that fires too soon
steps.body:
This script has a bug. Look at the preview: the runner never leaves the start.

The stop rule ends every run slower than 0.5 m/s. Every runner starts standing still, so every run ends on its first tick, and nobody can learn anything.

Stop runners for the right reason instead: no new ground for 3 seconds.

check.message: The test runner should get more than halfway.

hints: agent.stuckTime counts the seconds since the runner last got closer to the line.
Change the rule to stop "slow" when agent.stuckTime > 3 s.

steps.title: Keep a margin
steps.body:
The death penalty only speaks once it is too late. A small cost for getting close warns a runner while it can still turn.

The `let` line above the tick block sets `margin` to half a meter. `agent.spikeDistance` is the gap between the runner and the nearest spikes. Take a hundredth of a point for every tick it is under the margin.

check.message: Add a small negative reward that reads agent.spikeDistance.

hints: Compare agent.spikeDistance with margin in the condition.
